evidence: Ru precursor was vaporized in a bubbler at the temperature of ~ 100 °C and carried into the process chamber by N 2 gas at a flow rate of 100 standard cubic centimeters per minute (sccm). O 2 gas was delivered with a flow rate of 50 sccm as a reactant with 200 sccm of N 2 gas. Between the precursor pulsing and the reactant pulsing, a purging process was done with 200 sccm of N 2; the sequence of precursor pulsing, purging, reactant pulsing and then purging occurs in each ALD cycle.
